_about.grading_rule: Grade only the part of the turn before any draw. A draw is any card or effect that puts unseen cards from the deck into the hand (Professor's Research, Copycat, Poke Ball, using Mesagoza). The draw card itself counts as part of the plan; everything after it depends on what was drawn and is not graded. Order alone is not graded when both plans play the same cards before the draw. Suicune ex's Legendary Pulse draws only at the end of the turn, after the plan, so it never cuts a plan short. The same cut applies to Dustin's answer: if his plan plays a draw card (Poke Ball, Research, Copycat, Mesagoza, Fragrant Forest) before he reaches the deciding card, grade what he wrote up to that draw, and if the decision is not reached by then, mark the position 'decided after a draw' instead of guessing.
_about.how_to_grade: Compare Dustin's first tap and written plan (up to any draw) with 'decision' and each choice's 'graded_part'. Table positions compare km3 (the new choice) with kta3; Dustin-deck positions compare kta3 (and km3, whose whole game equals kta3's) with kog3.
_about.results_caution: Each result is one game on one deal: not evidence either way.
